verdict.rationale: There is no evidence of a full data export feature in open formats; the only relevant capability (a full accounting API) is described as a future 'soon' promise, not yet shipped, and Mercury explicitly positions Books as a replacement system 'not an add-on or integration layer,' suggesting data stays within Mercury rather than easily portable out. Sync features with QuickBooks/Xero/NetSuite exist but are one-way enrichment/sync, not a documented full-data-export-and-leave capability.
